description: Abstract Java class for a Vert.x-based authentication service, handling message bus communication, request processing, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: BaseAuthenticationService
classes.description: Abstract class providing a base implementation for an authentication service in Vert.x, managing message bus subscriptions and request handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the message consumer for authentication requests and calls doStart for additional startup procedures.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to create resources during startup; default implementation completes immediately.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unregisters the message consumer and calls doStop for additional shutdown procedures.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to release resources during shutdown; default implementation completes immediately.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, invokes authenticate, and replies or fails based on validation outcome.
